assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The concern is for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code I48.91 corresponds to paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
There is a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code Z86.73 corresponds to personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code G45.9 corresponds to transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The note states mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The monitoring was ordered given the need to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
The denial is on the basis of medical necessity as documented in the ordering indication
